sourceChecks.text: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「モアブの子ら」は軍事行動をする集団の名。族祖モアブ個人や土地としての用法とは区別。

sourceChecks.text: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「モアブの子ら」は軍事行動をする集団の名。族祖モアブ個人や土地としての用法とは区別。

sourceChecks.text: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「モアブの子ら」は軍事行動をする集団の名。族祖モアブ個人や土地としての用法とは区別。

sourceChecks.text: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「モアブの子ら」は軍事行動をする集団の名。族祖モアブ個人や土地としての用法とは区別。
